replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map submission has been denied for the following reasons.

-Too small: It is very easy to knock people off from the sides and there is little room for a strategic push. 

-Aesthetics: The block palette is too simple and does not look good. We suggest you add some more blocks to spice it up a bit. You may submit the map again after you work on those issues.
